info.name: WhatsApp Hidden Profiles API
info.description:
Keyed API for an OSINT app (`/api/v1`).

**Auth:** `X-API-Key: {{apiKey}}` (or `Authorization: Bearer {{apiKey}}`). Create a key in the dashboard at `/settings`.

**OSINT connection (WhatsApp next to RapidAPI keys)**
1. Save `baseUrl` + `apiKey` in OSINT settings.
2. `GET /status` — HTTP 200 = API connected. `whatsappAdded: false` = no WhatsApp linked yet. Render `accounts[].qrCodeDataUrl` as a barcode and poll until `ready: true`.
3. `POST /accounts` — add another WhatsApp (same as the dashboard + Add account). Poll `GET /accounts/:id` until QR appears, then scan.
4. `POST /accounts/:id/disconnect` — logout and get a new QR. `DELETE /accounts/:id` — remove a slot (not the last one).

**OSINT lookup flow**
1. `GET /profiles/:digits` — already stored? Use it. No WhatsApp call.
2. If 404 → `POST /lookup` — live fetch (returns SQLite cache when already fetched).
3. Download the photo from `profile.profilePicUrl`.
4. Bulk: `POST /queue` (chunks of ≤20,000) or `POST /lookups` (≤5,000, then poll).

Successful lookups persist into SQLite. Later `GET /profiles` / `GET /profiles/:digits` return the same fields plus an absolute photo URL.

request.description: Process is up. No API key.
SQLite `data/app.db` is readable.

item.name: 1. Connection
item.description: OSINT settings: save the API key, then call status. HTTP 200 = key/host OK. `whatsappAdded: false` means show the QR barcode from `accounts[].qrCodeDataUrl` and poll until a session is linked.

request.description: API connection check. Returns `ready`, `whatsappAdded`, `accounts[]` (each with `qrCodeDataUrl` when a scan is needed), and the queue worker. Lookups need `ready: true` unless the number is already in SQLite.

request.description: Same account objects as status, without the queue worker. OSINT settings can list these as connection cards. Saves `accountId` from the first slot.
Creates another WhatsApp slot (dashboard + Add account). HTTP 201. Poll `GET /accounts/:id` until `qrCodeDataUrl` is set, then scan. Saves `accountId`.

response.name: Created — scan QR
response.body:
{
  "success": true,
  "accountId": "2",
  "qrCodeDataUrl": "data:image/png;base64,...",
  "requiresQrScan": true,
  "ready": true,
  "whatsappAdded": true,
  "readyCount": 1,
  "accountCount": 2,
  "maxAccounts": 20,
  "message": "Account 2 added. Scan the QR code to connect."
}

request.description: Poll this after add/disconnect. When `status` is `scan_qr`, render `qrCodeDataUrl`. When `ready` is true, the session is linked.
Logs that session out and starts a new QR. The slot stays. Same as dashboard LOGOUT / RESET.
Removes the slot and logs it out. The last remaining account cannot be deleted (HTTP 400).

item.name: 2. Stored profiles (OSINT read)
item.description: Read from SQLite only — no WhatsApp call. Use this first from the OSINT app.

request.description: Paginated stored profiles (20/page). Query `q` matches digits, input phone, or display name. Omit `q` to list all. Each item includes full `profile` (name, about, business, `profilePicUrl`).

request.description: Newest first. Increment `page` until `page >= totalPages`.

item.name: 3. Live lookup
item.description: Fetches from WhatsApp if not already in SQLite (`reusedFromDb: true` means cache hit).

request.description: Synchronous. Returns SQLite cache if this number was fetched before (no WhatsApp call). Saves `digits` and `profilePicUrl` for the photo request.

response.name: Cached / live profile
response.body:

  "success": true,

request.description: Skip cache and call WhatsApp again. Needs a connected account.
Same as lookup, using `Authorization: Bearer whp_...` instead of `X-API-Key`.
Browser OSINT apps hit this first. Allowed origins: `OCEAN_CORS_ORIGINS` (default `*`).
Uses `profilePicUrl` saved by Lookup / Get stored profile. Photo URLs are public (`/api/media/...`). Run a profile request first.
Fallback when you already know international digits. 404 if that number has no saved image.

item.name: 5. Background queue (bulk / million)
item.description: Always-on worker: 50 live fetches per WhatsApp, then 20 min rest. Already stored numbers are skipped.

request.description: Stores numbers in SQLite. Max 20,000 per request — loop for a million. Duplicates are skipped. After the worker finishes, fetch with `GET /profiles/:digits`.

response.name: Accepted
response.body:
{
  "success": true,
  "accepted": 2,
  "skippedInvalid": 0,
  "skippedDuplicate": 0,
  "totalReceived": 2,
  "message": "Numbers stored in SQLite. The background worker fetches 50 per linked WhatsApp, then rests 20 minutes."
}

request.description: `pending` / `processing` / `done` / `failed` / `profiles` plus worker `phase` (`fetching`, `resting`, `waiting_whatsapp`).

item.name: 6. Async jobs (wait for results now)
item.description: Up to 5,000 numbers. Poll until `status` is `completed` or `failed`. Prefer `/queue` for huge lists.

request.description: HTTP 202. Saves `jobId` for the poll request.
Repeat until `status` is `completed` or `failed`. `results[]` are full profiles with absolute `profilePicUrl`.
